# Hachimi.ai · 哈基米道长

# When it's a lot, cast a hexagram.

[Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6787621766) · [Get it on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hachimi.hachimi_app)

## A tool built for professional fate readers.

### Enter a birth once, get both charts

One case gives you both Zi Wei Dou Shu and Ba Zi. True solar time is worked out once, so the two charts agree.

### Client records move with you

iPhone and iPad sync through iCloud. On Android, cases are saved with your system backup. Both can export a backup file.

### Three Zi Wei chart styles, Ba Zi to six pillars

Switch between San He, Flying Star and Four Transformations, with fortune layers down to the hour. Beyond the four pillars, Ba Zi has a six-pillar chart with major and annual cycles.

## One client, one case

Zi Wei, Ba Zi and every hexagram you cast for this client sit under one case.

1. **Create a case**: Enter a solar date, lunar date or four pillars, and pick the birthplace by province and city.
2. **Chart Zi Wei**: Once the birth is in, the Zi Wei chart is ready.
3. **Switch to Ba Zi**: Same birth details. No need to enter them again.
4. **Cast for this client**: Choose who the question is for. The hexagram and reading are filed under that case.
5. **Look back at every cast**: Past questions are listed by date; tap one to open that hexagram. Ask for this client again, and the Master picks up where the last reading left off.

## Four tools

### Zi Wei Dou Shu

Set star placement to match your school. Paste a star code and your chart matches a colleague's.

Chart Patterns are judged by rule, and each one names the layer it comes from. This part needs internet. Press and hold any word on the chart for its entry.

### Ba Zi charting

Clashes, combinations and harms are written out for the natal chart and for the cycles. Take notes on the same page.

The four pillars run from main star to Symbolic Stars, and you can choose the hidden-stem rulebook. Press and hold any word on the chart for its entry.

### Case library

Dozens of clients. Filter by group or day master and the one you need is there.

You can also filter by gender, zodiac animal and birth decade. Send a single case to a colleague, and it merges into their library when they open it.

### Mei Hua Yi Shu casting

Say two numbers to cast a hexagram, and the Master writes a reading.

Original, Nuclear and Resulting hexagrams and Host & Guest sit on one screen. A cast for a client is filed under that case, and you can add what happened later. You can cast without writing a question.

## Need a source for a reading? The classics are in the app, sorted by the five arts, and open offline.

## Frequently asked questions

### How is true solar time worked out?

From the birthplace longitude and the equation of time. Pick a province and city or type a longitude; born abroad, pick a time zone. Zi Wei and Ba Zi use the same hour.

### Do I need internet to chart?

No. Charts work in airplane mode. Chart Patterns, zizhan and the Four Pillars lookup need internet.

### How do I switch chart styles?

One tap at the bottom of the chart. Same birth, same Star Settings; the Taiji point and fortune layers follow.

### What does the Master remember?

What you asked for this client before. Ask for them again, and the reading picks up from last time. You can turn it off anytime.

### Do readings need internet?

Yes, with a daily limit. A third-party AI service writes the reading in the Master's voice.

Still have questions? [Contact Hachimi.ai](mailto:voice@hachimi.ai)

# Charting rules, your way

Below are the spots where charting apps most often disagree. Where there's a setting, set it to match your school.

Last updated 1 October 2026

- **True solar time**: Birth time is adjusted by birthplace longitude and the equation of time. Pick a province and city, or type a longitude. Born abroad? Choose a time zone.
- **Calendar**: Enter a solar date, lunar date or four pillars. The chart marks daylight saving, leap months, late zi hour and solar term changes.
- **Three chart styles**: One birth, three views: San He, Flying Star and Four Transformations. Switch at the bottom of the chart; the Taiji point and fortune layers follow.
- **Chart Patterns**: The app judges each pattern by rule and names the layer it comes from. This needs internet.
- **Star schools**: Schools place stars differently. Set each Star Settings item to match yours, or enter a star code.
- **Ba Zi**: Ba Zi uses the same birth as Zi Wei. The four-pillar table runs from main star to Nayin and Symbolic Stars. The six-pillar chart carries major and annual cycles; tap any slot and the whole table follows.
- **More chart methods**: Zizhan and the Four Pillars lookup are in the More menu and need internet. Screenshots and text charts are there too.

# Privacy Policy: Hachimi.ai (哈基米道长)

**Last updated: 2026-10-01**

Hachimi.ai (哈基米道长, “the App”) is a charting and question-reading tool for iOS and Android, run by Yuenchuk Investment Limited (元竹投資有限公司) in Hong Kong. This policy explains where the App keeps your cases and reading history, which features go online, and how to manage and delete them.

## 1. Where your cases and history are kept

Cases, reading history and the notes Hachimi keeps from past questions stay on your device. On iOS they sync to your iCloud; on Android they are saved to your Google Account with your system backup. There is no account to sign up for.

## 2. Features that go online

- **Online readings**: your question, the hexagram, and any chart owner's Ba Zi or past notes you choose to include go through our server to a third-party AI service, which writes Hachimi's reading. The App asks for your permission before the first one. We keep questions and readings on our server for a while, then delete them.
- **Chart Patterns, zizhan and the Four Pillars lookup**: the birth details or numbers they need go to our server, are calculated, and come straight back. We don't keep them.
- **Usage statistics**: the App sends anonymous usage counts and crash diagnostics so we can improve it. Statistics carry a random identifier, which you can reset under Me > Privacy and data.
- **Membership**: Apple or Google handles payment, and the App checks membership status with the store.

## 3. Permissions

The microphone turns what you say into text, and recognition happens on your device. Location is used only in zizhan, to read an approximate longitude once. On iOS, saving a share image writes it to your photo library.

## 4. Managing and deleting your data

- Under Me > Privacy and data, you can delete all reading data and reset the anonymous identifier. To turn off online readings, open Privacy Policy on that page and use the button at the bottom.
- Delete cases one by one in your case library.
- You manage copies in iCloud and in system backups in your phone's settings.
- Depending on where you live, you can ask to access, correct or delete your data, or withdraw consent. Just email us.

## 5. Age

The App is for users aged 13 and over.

## 6. Changes and contact

When this policy changes, the "Last updated" date changes with it.

Yuenchuk Investment Limited (元竹投資有限公司), Hong Kong
Email: voice@hachimi.ai

# Terms of Use: Hachimi.ai (哈基米道长)

**Last updated: 2026-10-01**

Hachimi.ai (哈基米道长, “the App”) is run by Yuenchuk Investment Limited (元竹投資有限公司) in Hong Kong. By using the iOS or Android version of the App, you agree to these terms.

## 1. The App

The App offers Zi Wei Dou Shu and Ba Zi charts, case management, Mei Hua Yi Shu question readings, Academy reading, and intimacy preference matching. Its content is for entertainment and traditional cultural learning.

## 2. Readings

Readings are written by a third-party AI service and may be inaccurate. Your decisions are your own. If you use charts or readings to serve other people, you are responsible for that service.

## 3. Your use

Use the App in line with the laws where you live. Get a person's consent before entering their birth details. The App is for users aged 13 and over.

## 4. Membership subscriptions

Membership is an auto-renewable subscription bought through the App Store or Google Play. The store shows the price and period at purchase, and it renews at the end of each period. On iOS, turn off auto-renewal in your Apple Account's subscription settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. On Android, cancel on the Google Play subscriptions page before the next charge. After you cancel, membership lasts until the end of the current period. Apple or Google handles refunds under their own rules.

## 5. License

The App is licensed to you. The iOS version is also covered by Apple's Standard End User License Agreement, and the Android version by the Google Play Terms of Service.

## 6. Limitation of liability

The App is provided as is. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages.

## 7. Changes and contact

When these terms change, the "Last updated" date changes with them. Continuing to use the App means you accept the change.
